---
title: Settings commands
description: The commands of the Settings panel of huron --help.
---

<!-- Generated by scripts/cli_reference.py from the help of the huron CLI. After you change the help, run `uv run python scripts/cli_reference.py`. -->

The commands `huron --help` lists under **Settings**.

| Command                                 | Description                                                      |
| --------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`login`](/docs/reference/cli/login/)   | Log in with the institutional identity provider.                 |
| [`logout`](/docs/reference/cli/logout/) | Delete the stored tokens.                                        |
| [`whoami`](/docs/reference/cli/whoami/) | Show who you are, your LDAP groups and the roles that they hold. |
| [`config`](/docs/reference/cli/config/) | Show or change the CLI configuration.                            |
